_comment: One 2x generation target per ArtSlotId, derived from the split-02 reserved layout box (registry aspectRatio applied to the slot's rendered CSS box at the reference desktop viewport 1280px, portrait slots at the phone viewport 390px). Each entry records its derivation so the numbers are auditable. CI reads targetW/targetH + tolerancePx; the byte ceilings and AVIF-only rule live in the dimensions test, not here.

hero-desktop.derivation: 16/9 full-bleed hero, approved WOPR console art (325ef0c: charcoal cabinet, red/amber/green LED band, CRT WOPR label) ships native 1920x1080

hero-portrait.derivation: 9/16 full-bleed hero at the 390px phone box, 2x of 540x960: 1080x1920

hero-return.derivation: 16/9 returning-hero reuses the hero-desktop box: 1280x720 CSS, 2x -> 2560x1440

menu-rack.derivation: 4/1 menu backdrop rack spanning the 1024px content column: 1024x256 CSS, 2x -> 2048x512

bezel-texture.derivation: 1/1 tiling bezel texture authored at 512x512 CSS source tile, 2x -> 1024x1024

countdown-insert.derivation: 3/1 countdown insert strip over the 768px cabinet readout band: 768x256 CSS, 2x -> 1536x512

briefing-outlook.derivation: 4/3 briefing panel at the 768px briefing column: 768x576 CSS, 2x -> 1536x1152
